specs.title: TC-UC01-M main: employee submits a valid request at the allowance boundary (D = A = 5)
TC-UC01-A1 alternative: employee revises the dates after the working-day preview
TC-UC01-A2 alternative: employee abandons the request before submitting
TC-UC01-E1 exception: overlap with an active request at the inclusive boundary, then corrected
TC-UC01-E2 exception: requested days exceed the remaining entitlement (D = A + 1), then shortened
TC-UC02-M main: team manager approves pending request k at the balance boundary (D = available)
TC-UC02-A1 alternative: team manager rejects k; no allowance is charged and the dates are released
TC-UC02-A2 alternative: administrator approves a pending request of another team
TC-UC02-E1 exception: k was decided by another approver after the page loaded (stale view)
TC-UC02-E2 exception: manager attempts to decide their own pending request
OBJ-UC02-01 blocked: approval that exceeds the employee remaining entitlement is refused
